SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

4. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

6. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.

7. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   D. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

12. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

14. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

15. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
